stores.name: App Store
stores.notify_label: App Store Server Notifications URL (Production and Sandbox, Version 2)
stores.refunds: App Store Server Notifications V2 (REFUND, REVOKE, EXPIRED)

secrets.label: Issuer ID (Users and Access > Integrations; the same for every key)
secrets.name: apple_issuer_id

secrets.label: In-App Purchase key ID (Users and Access > Integrations > In-App Purchase, not App Store Connect API)
secrets.name: apple_key_id

secrets.label: Private key .p8 of the In-App Purchase key
secrets.name: apple_private_key_p8

secrets.label: Optional secret in the /notify/apple URL
secrets.name: apple_notification_secret

secrets.label: Team key ID (Users and Access > Integrations > App Store Connect API > Team Keys, App Manager; catalog import and App Store setup, optional)
secrets.name: apple_connect_key_id

secrets.label: Private key .p8 of the Team key (catalog import and App Store setup, optional)
secrets.name: apple_connect_private_key_p8

stores.name: Amazon Appstore
stores.notify_label: Real-Time Notifications endpoint (Developer Console → the app → App Services)
stores.refunds: Real-Time Notifications (*_CANCELLED) and subscription re-checks by the worker

secrets.label: Amazon Appstore shared key (Developer Console → Shared Key)
secrets.name: amazon_shared_secret

stores.store_app_id_label: Package name (the same as the Google Play build's is fine)

stores.name: Steam
stores.refunds: GetReport polling by the worker (Refunded, Chargedback, fraud refunds)

secrets.label: Steam publisher Web API key (Steamworks → Users & Permissions → Manage Groups)
secrets.name: steam_publisher_key

stores.name: Stripe
stores.notify_label: Webhook endpoint (Stripe Dashboard → Developers → Webhooks → Add destination)

secrets.label: Stripe secret key (sk_live_… / sk_test_…, or a restricted rk_ key)
secrets.name: stripe_secret_key

secrets.label: Webhook signing secret of the endpoint (whsec_…)
secrets.name: stripe_webhook_secret

stores.store_app_id_label: App id (any unique id of the web build)

stores.name: Xsolla
stores.notify_label: Webhook URL (Publisher Account → the project → Project settings → Webhooks)

secrets.label: Xsolla project ID (Publisher Account → the project; not secret)
secrets.name: xsolla_project_id

secrets.label: Xsolla API key (Company settings → API keys, or the project's API keys)
secrets.name: xsolla_api_key

secrets.label: Xsolla project secret key (Project settings → Webhooks → Secret key)
secrets.name: xsolla_webhook_secret

secrets.label: Xsolla Login project ID, for moving inventory of the old device-id login (optional, not secret)
secrets.name: xsolla_login_project_id

stores.store_app_id_label: App id (any unique id; one Xsolla project per build)

stores.name: Huawei AppGallery
stores.notify_label: Server notification URL (AppGallery Connect → the app → In-App Purchases → Settings, version v2)
stores.refunds: Server notifications (looked up again) and subscription re-checks by the worker

secrets.label: App ID (AppGallery Connect → the app → App information; the OAuth client id)
secrets.name: huawei_client_id

secrets.label: App secret (the OAuth client secret)
secrets.name: huawei_client_secret

secrets.label: Secret in the server notification URL (/notify/huawei?…&secret=…)
secrets.name: huawei_notify_secret

secrets.label: Site of the IAP services: europe (default), asia, russia, china or carrier
secrets.name: huawei_site

stores.store_app_id_label: Package name (the same as the Google Play build's is fine)

stores.name: Telegram Stars
stores.notify_label: Bot webhook URL (setWebhook with secret_token = telegram_webhook_secret; the Setup tab sets it)

secrets.label: Bot token from @BotFather (123456:ABC…)
secrets.name: telegram_bot_token

secrets.label: Webhook secret_token (1-256 characters of A-Z a-z 0-9 _ -)
secrets.name: telegram_webhook_secret

stores.store_app_id_label: App id (any unique id of the Telegram build)

stores.name: Samsung Galaxy Store
stores.notify_label: Instant Server Notification URL (Seller Portal → the app → In App Purchase: the ISN URL of each item)
stores.refunds: Instant Server Notifications (looked up again) and subscription re-checks by the worker

secrets.label: Service account ID (Seller Portal → Assistance → API Service)
secrets.name: samsung_service_account_id

secrets.label: Private key of the service account (PEM, downloaded when the account was created)
secrets.name: samsung_private_key

secrets.label: IAP public key (Seller Portal): verifies Instant Server Notifications
secrets.name: samsung_iap_public_key

stores.store_app_id_label: Package name (the same as the Google Play build's is fine)

stores.name: Meta Horizon Store
stores.refunds: Not reported by Meta (no server notifications); subscriptions are re-checked by the worker when their period ends

secrets.label: App ID (Developer Dashboard → the app → Development → API)
secrets.name: meta_app_id

secrets.label: App secret (the same API page)
secrets.name: meta_app_secret

stores.store_app_id_label: App id (any unique id, e.g. the package name)
